A second projection/control plane is useful only if its failure ancestry is meaningfully diverse.

general_research_delta: Multi-view or multi-agent redundancy is not independence unless failure ancestry differs. This joins R5 evidence-identity, routing-completeness and causal-replay laws into one stronger rule: diversity claims require provenance-diverse failure modes, not merely separate names/processes/views.
